decisive_items: A conserved splice-site mutation in SUFU gene (c.757-2A>G) in all tumor and normal tissue samples
buds and cords of basaloid cells enclosing small cystic spaces
response.rationale: The combination of histopathological features and genetic mutation in the SUFU gene supports the diagnosis of Nevoid Basal Cell Carcinoma Syndrome (Gorlin Syndrome).

rejected.why: Lack of genetic information and family history to support the diagnosis of Infundibulocystic Basal Cell Carcinoma as a syndrome.
Presence of contradicting information, such as the absence of palmar or plantar pits.
Lack of specificity and genetic information to support the diagnosis of basal cell carcinoma as a syndrome.
